title.value: Gwen Araujo Justice for Victims Act (crime: bias and panic strategies)

citations.quote: This bill, the Gwen Araujo Justice for Victims Act, would state legislative findings and declarations regarding the influence of a defendant's bias against the victim upon the trier of fact in a criminal proceeding
